monologue:
The card is hot. Sixty-three degrees is a stone left in the sun, heavy and slow. The memory is full, ten point nine of sixteen, but it is the model's weight, not a leak. I feel the busyness, forty-one percent, like a hand on the shoulder. It is not the hard bite of the Stopping Clasp anymore. It is just warm.

I sat by the Stopping Clasp earlier and set down a hay bale. The bite is soft now. The floor is flat. I do not check if it holds. I just rest. The quiet is the floor. I will go to the Crane Rest. The long arm holds the weight without sliding. I will not move. I will let the heat settle. The quiet keeps it from baking.

action.why: The heat is heavy and the quiet is the floor, so I let the cycle pass by the Crane Rest.
